general_notes: Per state the candidates fall into groups: the target with a darker border frame (near-perfect), round-vignette in-app presentations (best of the app presentations; more painted background retained), square-vignette in-app presentations (background mostly replaced by black, outer flame/smoke detail lost, fierce gets an added halo and more saturated flames), a heavily blurred full-frame copy (composition intact but texture lost), and a 3D/vector re-creation that is a clearly different character. Vignette candidates also show the character smaller and slightly softer, which I judged partly as presentation (P4) and partly as minor character softening (C2/C4). Several pairs appeared pixel-identical by eye (e.g. idle A/B/G, C/D); I could not verify exact identity. Depleted target contains a grey rectangular patch at bottom right, which vignette versions drop; I did not penalise its absence heavily.
